kinora-effect.description:
Kinora Effect is an open-source motion graphics and visual effects editor designed for Android. It brings a desktop-style creative workflow to mobile devices, offering a professional editing environment with timeline-based composition tools, layered project management, visual effects controls, and touch-friendly workflows optimized for productivity. The app is built to give creators a powerful and flexible workspace for producing polished motion graphics and visual content directly from their Android devices.

With advanced panel layouts, composition preview, project editing tools, UI scaling options, and Android file management support, Kinora Effect is tailored for designers, artists, and content creators who need a capable visual editing experience in a mobile-first environment.
